results.content: Apple is strategically delaying the entry-level iPhone 18 until Spring 2027, while launching the higher-margin iPhone 18 Pro models in September 2026. This move aims to boost average selling prices and revenue during the crucial holiday sales quarter. Consumers seeking an upgrade this autumn will face a choice: pay an estimated $200 premium for the Pro model or retain their older device. The iPhone 18 Pro will also be the exclusive gateway to the full suite of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI [...] Apple is set to launch the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max on Sept. 12. results.content: Nikkei reports Apple plans to launch at least five new iPhone models between the second half of 2026 and the first half of 2027. That lines up with expectations that the foldable will join updated versions of the four models already in Apple's line. And the company has already started ramping up production of its foldable iPhone, according to Nikkei, instructing suppliers to prepare to produce 10 million foldables this year, an increase over earlier production forecasts.
